source_visual_observations: Triangle ACD below horizontal ray AB; C=80°; AD bisects angle CAB.
audit.independent_solution: Parallel AB and CD give CAB=180−80=100°. AD bisects CAB, so BAD=50°. By alternate interior angles, ADC=50°, choice A.
